'''David W. Krogmann''' (1934 &ndash; January 22, 2016) was an American biologist and a professor of biochemistry at [[Purdue University]]. He is known for his work in photosynthesis in chloroplasts and cyanobacteria.<ref name="Kerfeld2016" />

He discovered the [[Orange Carotenoid Protein]] of [[cyanobacteria]] in 1981 and helped solve its crystal structure.<ref name="Kay_HoltKrogmann1981" /><ref name="KerfeldSawaya2003" />
